skill_route.resolution: The mission-approved production registry entry and TC-FF6-MACH-001 bind complete ProductContract obligation slices to format-feature-expansion. The older generic route does not include digest-bound installed-package and independent-oracle requirements.

requested_operation: implement a bounded content-addressed notebook trust notary with official-compatible pluggable storage, explicit signing and revocation, and edit-invalidates-trust behavior

inputs.root_cause: The package had validation and active-content marking but no cryptographic trust boundary. Validity could therefore be confused with reviewed/trusted content, and consumers had no pluggable compute/store/verify/revoke contract whose result automatically changed when notebook content changed.
inputs.affected_layer: IPYNB security trust boundary, public API, package security documentation

defect_reproduction.outcome: Test collection failed because format_factory.ipynb exported no HmacNotebookNotary or associated trust types.

implementation.notary: HmacNotebookNotary requires caller-supplied key material of at least 32 bytes and allows SHA-256, SHA-384, or SHA-512 HMAC.
implementation.official_compatibility: Signature traversal matches the official nbformat notary for valid notebooks, including sorted mapping keys and exclusion of legacy metadata.signature.
implementation.store_protocol: SignatureStore uses the official store_signature/check_signature/remove_signature method contract; the included memory store is thread-safe, bounded, and process-local.
implementation.trust_lifecycle: sign, verify/check_signature, revoke/unsign, and retained-record revocation are explicit operations; load, validate, sanitize, and write never sign.
implementation.edit_invalidation: Trust is keyed by the current content digest. Any content edit computes a different record and verifies as untrusted without mutating notebook metadata.
implementation.validity_separation: Structured TrustVerification is independent from ValidationReport; valid notebooks can be untrusted and no cell metadata trusted flag is written.
implementation.boundedness: Signature traversal is iterative and streaming, with nesting, entry, input-byte, and decoded-byte limits.
implementation.preservation: Signature computation never mutates the notebook and ignores, but does not delete or trust, the legacy metadata.signature value.
implementation.tradeoff: Exact content restoration restores content-addressed trust. Callers that require permanent invalidation retain and revoke the original TrustRecord. Persistent store protection and secret rotation remain application responsibilities.
